heading: Suits to recover wrongful or fraudulent payments
lead: The Postal Service shall request the Attorney General to bring a suit to recover with interest any payment made from moneys of, or credit granted by, the Postal Service as a result of—

tree.text: misconduct of an officer or employee of the Postal Service.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective July 1, 1971, pursuant to Resolution No. 71–9 of the Board of Governors. See section 15(a) of Pub. L. 91–375, set out as a note preceding section 101 of this title.
